details.description: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash is DeepSeek's Mixture-of-Experts chat model, released September 10, 2026, offered on Together AI. Its Hugging Face model card describes a Causal Encoder-Decoder architecture with 552 billion backbone parameters that activates only 8 billion for input processing and 16 billion for output generation. DeepSeek's launch announcement states new pre-training methods and larger-scale reinforcement-learning post-training give it benchmark results ahead of the larger DeepSeek-V4-Pro, and that it replaces the retired DeepSeek-V4-Flash and DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp models, which now route to it for compatibility.
advantages: Scores 90.9 on GPQA Diamond, a graduate-level science reasoning benchmark, per DeepSeek's Hugging Face model card.
Passes 90.6% of tasks on Terminal-Bench 2.1, an agentic terminal-use benchmark.
Resolves 74.2% of tasks on DeepSWE v1.1, a software-engineering agent benchmark.
Resolves 88.1% of tasks on CyberGym, a cybersecurity-research agent benchmark.
DeepSeek reports its new pre-training and larger-scale RL post-training give benchmark results ahead of the larger DeepSeek-V4-Pro model.
disadvantages: No audio input or output; Bud's catalog records this model as text input/output only, though DeepSeek's own model card describes a built-in vision encoder for image input.
use_cases: Software-engineering agents that resolve repository bug-fixing tasks (DeepSWE v1.1)
Long-context agentic workflows using up to a 1,000,000-token context window
General chat and reasoning tasks (GPQA Diamond, Humanity's Last Exam)

notes: Catalog's max_input_tokens (1,048,576) matches the model's stated 1-million-token context window. The catalog records this model's modality as text_input/text_output only; DeepSeek's Hugging Face card and launch post describe a native vision encoder processing images and text together, but that disagrees with the catalog's text-only modality, so vision-related claims were kept out of the details and the catalog's value was kept per instructions. This is Together AI's listing of the same underlying model already covered under a sibling slug for Fireworks AI; no separate GitHub repository was found for the model itself (DeepSeek's 'deepseek-recipe' repo is a production-serving recipe, not the model), so github_url is left null. No language list is published by DeepSeek for this model, so languages is left empty.
